intro.text: A five-year-old girl from Hearthstone whom Kaladin tries to save after a bad fall.

items.text: Miasal fell, badly breaking her leg and hurting her head. Kaladin was nearby and cauterized the wound to stop the bleeding, but she died anyway. Her father, Harl, was distraught. Lirin praised what Kaladin had done, but Kaladin saw her death as his own failure.
